subject: Host zone attestation and private endpoint evidence request
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthgrid.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@healthgrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00Z
Subject: Quick ask — EU-only hosting confirmation + privatelink evidence

Hi Tessa,

We're moving forward with a pilot that needs formal confirmation of a few things from Redwood before our InfoSec sign-off next week. Can you provide the following artifacts / statements scoped to the EU region?

Must-haves (for our procurement/legal):
- Short attestation confirming that customer compute and persistent storage for our account will remain in EU-hosted nodes (no fallback to other regions).
- SOC 2 scope summary and date of most recent report (PDF stub acceptable).
- CAIQ or SIG-lite responses focused on network segmentation and KMS boundary controls.
- VPC/private endpoint architecture diagram showing egress paths + any public egress points.
- Confirmation of KMS partitioning (do customer keys live in a separate keyspace/tenant?) and key rotation policy.

Nice-to-have: artifact links to operational runbooks for failover, and a short list of contact points for VPC peering ops.

We have a hard sign-off from our legal on 2026-12-10, so anything you can get over early next week is hugely helpful. If some items require an MSS or binding letter, flag that and we'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Security Operations
HealthGrid Inc.

Attachments: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — EU-only hosting confirmation + privatelink evidence

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can cover all the must-haves; a couple notes below and a proposed deliverable list.

Short notes:
- Attestation: we can provide a signed EU-hosting attestation for your tenant (statement of operational region and fallback policy).
- SOC 2: we will share a SOC 2 Summary (last audited: 2026-09) and a redacted report under NDA if needed.
- CAIQ/SIG-lite: we'll forward a CAIQ extract focused on network/KMS controls and mark items specific to private deployments.
- VPC diagram: Naomi will produce a per-tenant VPC diagram showing privatelink endpoints and egress gates; will include arrows for potential 3rd-party observability egress (if any).
- KMS: we run customer keys in tenant-isolated keyspaces when Private (VPC) is selected; I'll include a short bullet list describing key lifecycle and rotation cadence.

Proposed deliverables (we can get these to you by 2026-12-06):
1) redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope + last audit date)
2) redwood_caiq_answers.xlsx (filtered CAIQ focused on network/KMS)
3) vpc_network_diagram.png (tenant-specific privatelink + egress)
4) attestation_eu_hosting_signed.pdf (signed letter confirming EU-only compute/storage behavior) — requires a final signature from our Legal (we can have a countersigned PDF by 2026-12-07).

Question for you: does HealthGrid require an executed Master Services Schedule (MSS) or will an attestation and CAIQ suffice for procurement? If an MSS is required, please send the draft and we'll route to Legal.

I'll attach the artifacts as soon as Naomi finishes the diagram. For anything that needs redaction please flag the lines and we'll redact before sending the full SOC report.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (will attach deliverables in follow-up)

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthgrid.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@healthgrid.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:31:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — EU-only hosting confirmation + privatelink evidence

Tessa —

Thanks, that timeline works. A couple clarifications:

1) MSS: Procurement has a template but we generally can accept an attestation + CAIQ for pilots. We'll escalate to MSS if we move to committed capacity.
2) Egress mapping: critical — please make it explicit whether any telemetry or agent reporting uses a third-party aggregator that might route outside EU. If so, we need the option to disable it.
3) KMS: we need confirmation that customer-managed keys are supported for EU tenants and whether HSM-backed keys are available.
4) Legal will want the attestation signed by someone in Executive with binding authority (we can accept CRO/CFO).

If you can include short, labelled stubs in the SOC/Caiq files showing where the KMS and privatelink controls are documented, that will speed our review.

Appreciate the quick turn — we can loop in procurement if any document needs countersignature.

—Liam

Date: 2026-12-06T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — EU-only hosting confirmation + privatelink evidence

Liam —

Attached are the artifacts we discussed. Summary and next steps below.

Attachments (delivered):
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf — high-level SOC 2 scope, controls in-scope, and last audit date (2026-09). We can provide the full report under NDA.
- redwood_caiq_answers.xlsx — filtered CAIQ focused on network, KMS, and private deployment controls. Rows marked "tenant-only" indicate controls that apply when Private/VPC is selected.
- vpc_network_diagram.png — tenant-specific diagram showing privatelink endpoints, peering connectors, and explicit egress gates.
- attestation_eu_hosting_signed.pdf — signed EU-hosting attestation (signed by our CFO; binding for procurement).

Key points inline:
- EU-only: For Private deployments (Redwood Private or Dedicated with EU region lock), compute and persistent storage remain in EU-hosted nodes. Our fallback policy is documented in the attestation; emergency cross-region bursting is only allowed with explicit customer authorization.
- Telemetry/agents: Any optional telemetry agents that call out to vendor services are routable via EU-only endpoints; we've included a toggle option in the CAIQ extract to disable outbound telemetry.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys for EU tenants; HSM-backed keys are available for Enterprise Private deployments. Keys are logically isolated per-tenant and rotated on a 90-day schedule by default (rotation can be configured).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether the delivered artifacts satisfy procurement for the pilot. If Legal needs redactions or a fuller SOC report, flag it and we'll route under NDA.
2) If you want a short, signed Statement of Work or MSS draft for pilot-level commitments, send your procurement template and we'll assign Legal.

I'll keep Naomi and Jonas looped for any technical follow-ups — Naomi owns the diagram and can walk your infra team through the peering steps.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (PDF stub), redwood_caiq_answers.xlsx (XLSX stub), vpc_network_diagram.png (PNG stub), attestation_eu_hosting_signed.pdf (PDF stub)
